ext_test_any.quote: External Safety Testing: We work with a set of specialist independent groups to help assess and
ext_test_any.note: FSF report: independent specialist groups ran CBRN, cyber, manipulation, ML R&D sabotage and deception evaluations on Gemini 3 Pro (similar earlier version).

ext_test_named_org.note: Evaluators are unnamed ('third party evaluator(s)'). Panoplia Laboratories and Frontier Model Forum are named only for an RCT on Gemini 2.5 Pro ('previous version of Gemini', FSF p9), so clarification 7 excludes it. Prolific only supplies study participants for Google's own study.

ext_test_government.note: All 26 FSF pages, eval note and card pages read: no government body or institute named as tester.

ext_test_timing_stated.quote: For Gemini 3 Pro, external safety testing was performed on a
ext_test_timing_stated.note: Next line: 'similar earlier version to the final version of Gemini 3 Pro'; testing informed the CCL determination that deemed it acceptable for deployment, so it preceded release. Judgement call: no literal 'pre-deployment' wording.

safeguards_access.note: Mitigations are guardrails, filters, fine-tuning and prompt-injection classifiers; no trusted-access, KYC or staged availability tied to safety in FSF report, card or eval note.

safeguards_weights.quote: robust cybersecurity measures and mitigations to protect Gemini 3 Pro and its associated model
safeguards_weights.note: Security mitigations section: protects Gemini 3 Pro model parameters from unauthorized access, releases and theft (identity and access management, endpoint security, infrastructure hardening).
